newsitem.title: UK: UK's Unichem says sales up in three units.
newsitem.headline: UK's Unichem says sales up in three units.

text.p: British drug wholesaler and retailer UniChem Plc said on Wednesday that its group turnover in the four months to April, 1997 had increased in its all three divisions on both total and like-for-like basis.
Unichem said its wholesale division grew ahead of estimated market growth despite difficulties caused by an early entry of a generic version of ulcer drug Zantac in the UK market.
Unichem handles Zantac for Glaxo which was the sole owner of the patent untill recently.
"This is expected to result in slightly lower full year operating margins in this division," the company said.
Its retail division had performed in line with expectations and continued to show gains in turnover and operating margin over the year-ago period.
"Our core businesses have grown their market shares and are well positioned to achieve long-term growth. Our balance sheet and cashflows remain strong," the company said.
